sourceBoundary: Includes only the source page section titled X-Men Events & Major Stories (2001 to 2015), and only entries where that page itself gives an exact issue number or issue range. Linked event rows, collection-only commerce links, forum-only pointers, and contextual prose are excluded unless the issue numbers are printed in this source section.
excludedSourceReferences: House of M, Decimation, Avengers vs. X-Men, Death of Wolverine, Axis, and Marvel Now launch rows are linked event or era references without issue rows on this page
Messiah CompleX links to a separate review instead of printing issue rows on this page
X-Infernus and X-Necrosha are collection-only references with contextual prose but no exact issue range on this page
Guardians of the Galaxy and X-Men: Black Vortex points to a forum reading order instead of printing the issue rows on this page
Classic X-Men and modern X-Men hub links are contextual navigation, not issue-bearing recommendations in the selected section
